$comment: Knowledge Engine — cross-KB typed edges (knowledge-foundation CONTRACTS.md §3). Frozen at major 1 from the reviewed issue #7 draft with one documented adjustment (schemas/kb/README.md): observed (digest pin) is required so relations participate in deterministic sync like every other record; lifecycle stays optional (edge review rides on endpoint records in the MVP). Endpoints must resolve to records in the same store at write time (dangling edges are write-time errors — the KB validator and ingest enforce this). Edge semantics: mapsTo/adaptedFrom connect UI sources WITHIN the developer-owned class; neighborOf connects across the capability-class boundary to Page Builder native (never mapsTo — admin-editability is a different capability class; enforced by the KB validator). implements requires business-function evidence; mapsTo never implies implements (no false equivalence between UI appearance and business functionality).
title: Knowledge Engine — KB relation record

id.$comment: Stable slug; deterministic derivation (hash of type+from+to) is acceptable as long as it is documented and stable.

edgeType.$comment: Core graph edges (issue #7) + KB-2 provenance relations (audit-formalized) + KB-3 chain relations. Grouped in CONTRACTS.md §3.

authority.$comment: confirmed = direct evidence (e.g. registry source_component + provenance doc); probable = naming/semantic match without direct evidence. PROBABLE edges must never be presented as confirmed by queries or planners.

projectId.$comment: REQUIRED when either endpoint is a KB-3 record; forbidden on edges between KB-1/KB-2 shared records (those are shared infrastructure, not client data).

kb.$comment: 'evidence' endpoints point at checkable artifacts (state JSON, PRs, screenshots, gate tables) via their src:/locator identity.

id.$comment: A record id (cap:/dat:/uic:/req:/uxi:/cmp:/dec:/apr:/risk:/oq:/con:/src:) or an artifact locator for kb=evidence.
